LESSON 37 / ADDITIONAL INTERVIEW CONCEPT
Template element and document fragments

Template content is inert until instantiated. JavaScript can clone template.content and insert the
fragment into the live document.
template එකෙ ඇතුJළේ markup එකෙ මුලින් page එකෙට render Jවන්Jන් නුහු. JavaScript clone කෙරලා live DOM එකෙට add කෙරන්න පුළුවන්.
An e-commerce page repeats a product card layout.
<template> · Live DOM · Product card #1 · Product card · clone · Not rendered yet · Product card #2

Read the diagram: The template is a reusable markup definition. Cloning its content produces a
fragment; appending that fragment inserts its children into the live page.
Expected result: The page displays one Product article after the clone is appended.
Interview question: Why use template rather than a hidden div?
Answer: Its content is designed to remain inert until instantiated.
Practice: Clone a template three times.
